name: ESEF_ARELLE_PARSE

sha256.note: per-output evidence hashes (facts.jsonl, oim.json.gz, arelle-log.json) in each {FID}.model_summary.json

findings: All 6 ESEF report packages load fully offline under Arelle 2.44.0 with R10-pinned taxonomy packages: DTS resolves completely (84 docs FY2024 / 88 FY2025), ioerr=0, zero download attempts.
Fact preservation verified: QName, value/xValue, context (entity, period start/end/instant/forever), unit, decimals, nil, explicit+typed dimension paths, language. Fact counts 833-1952 per filing.
Control A (Arelle Python API vs Arelle saveLoadableOIM xBRL-JSON): normalized fact multisets equal, concept coverage equal, decimals/nil distributions equal for all 6 filings.

Control B (Arelle vs Brel on SAN-FY2025): Brel's 363 reported concepts are fully contained in Arelle's 403 (concepts_only_brel=0). Brel drops facts without iXBRL format attributes and surfaces no dimensions -> partial oracle only, not authoritative, no fact-level parity.
All corpus contexts use explicit dimensions only (typed-dimension path implemented, not triggered).
ESEF validation runs under validate/ESEF + disclosureSystem esef-2022/esef-2024; findings (missingMandatoryMarkups, formula warnings, etc.) are filing-level, preserved per filing.

R11 run amended R10: esef_cor.xsd transitively imports IFRS full_ifrs and the xbrl.org LEI module; both pinned (canonical per-file downloads + locally-assembled packages) after the official IFRS ZIP proved login-gated.
limitations: Control B covers one representative filing (SAN-FY2025) by design; Brel is an oracle, not authoritative.
Fact footnote relationships counted (0 observed) but not extracted into the inventory.
OIM comparison uses xBRL-JSON; OIM-CSV equivalence is transitive via the same Arelle model.
IFRS/LEI taxonomy pins are canonical per-file downloads in locally-assembled packages (official IFRS ZIP requires login); documented in R10.
